text: 我和我老婆从认识到结婚到婚后生活，经历了我的3大转变阶段，目测很多男同胞都有过类似的经历。
en: From first meeting my wife to getting married and our life afterwards, I went through three major stages of transformation, and I reckon many fellow men have had similar experiences.

text: 第一阶段：好好先生
en: Stage One: Mr Nice Guy

text: 这里的好好先生，倒不是指脾气，而是指自我表现。
en: Here, 'Mr Nice Guy' does not refer to one's temper, but rather to self-presentation.

text: 因为我和老婆是相亲认识的，所以在两个人最开始接触的时候，我总是力求把自己最好的一面，或者【伪造】出来的最好一面展示给对方。
en: Because my wife and I met through an arranged introduction, at the very start of our contact I always strove to show her my best side, or rather the best side I had [fabricated].

text: 这一点上，人类比动物虚伪的多，因为动物尽管也展示自己最好的一面，但是好歹不会用假数据，但是人类为了面子那真是没什么事干不出来的。
en: On this point, humans are far more hypocritical than animals, because although animals also show their best side, at least they do not use fake data, whereas humans, for the sake of face, are truly capable of anything.

text: 于是在我老婆的眼里，我变成了一个有素养的高级知识分子，有良好的家教，事业心重，注重生活品质。
en: And so in my wife's eyes, I became a cultured, highly educated intellectual, with good upbringing, a strong career drive, and an attention to quality of life.

text: 经历了一系列的坑蒙拐骗后，老婆骗到手了，于是恶魔的爪牙暴露了，狰狞的嘴脸显现了，美好的面具被撕破了。
en: After a series of deceits and trickery, I had her fooled into marrying me, and then the devil's claws were bared, the ferocious face was revealed, and the beautiful mask was torn away.

text: 我老婆突然发现我以前的一切似乎都是不真实的。
en: My wife suddenly realised that everything about me before seemed untrue.

text: 主要表现有以下几个方面：
en: The main manifestations are as follows:

text: 第二阶段：丧心病狂
en: Stage Two: Completely Unhinged

text: --学识浅薄，平时偶尔用英语对个话，语法和发音都无力吐槽，去菜场买个菜，5个馒头5个包子要多少钱居然需要心算半分钟；
en: --Shallow learning: I occasionally speak a bit of English in daily life, but the grammar and pronunciation are simply beyond words; when going to the market to buy vegetables, working out the cost of five steamed buns and five baozi actually takes me half a minute of mental arithmetic;

text: --举止粗鲁，吃饭的时候一筷子夹她3筷子的内容，吃的嗨起来了还bia叽嘴；
en: --Rude manners: at the dinner table I'd grab with one chopstick what took her three chopsticks to serve, and when I got into my food I'd even smack my lips;

text: --生活邋遢，衣服一周一洗，不做衣物的区分，基本就是把所有的衣服往洗衣机里一丢就万事大吉，洗完也直接就往衣架上一丢就听天由命；
en: --Sloppy living: I washed clothes once a week with no sorting whatsoever, basically just chucking all the clothes into the washing machine and calling it a day, then once washed simply tossing them onto the hangers and leaving them to fate;

text: --性格惫懒，上班之外的时间除了玩游戏就是睡觉，偶尔有点小爱好，也跟下一条相关；
en: --Lazy disposition: outside of work, my time was spent either playing games or sleeping, with the occasional minor hobby, which ties in with the next point;

text: --爱好诡异，作为一个北方男性，平时用来打发时间的所谓爱好居然是十字绣和钻石画，也是娘炮到可以了；
en: --Bizarre hobbies: as a northern man, the so-called hobbies I used to pass the time turned out to be cross-stitch and diamond painting, which is about as effeminate as it gets;

text: --脾气炸裂，如果说爱好娘炮你倒是性脾气也娘炮呀，结果脾气偏偏炸裂的不行。
en: --Explosive temper: if your hobbies are effeminate, you might as well have an effeminate temper too, yet instead the temper was explosively fierce.

text: 南北粗口融会贯通，唱念做打基功扎实，吵起架来跟枪子一样。
en: My vulgarities blended the north and south, my grounding in the full craft of quarrelling was solid, and when I argued it was like gunfire.

text: 为了这事刚结婚那会没少吵架，甚至还发生过肢体冲突（女权主义请放心，我是单方面的挨揍，别跟我提家暴，我也想说家暴来着）。
en: Over this, in the early days of marriage we argued no end, and there were even physical altercations (feminists, rest assured, I was the one getting beaten unilaterally; don't bring up domestic violence with me — I'd be the one wanting to call it domestic violence).

text: 出于搞好家庭团结，促进社会主义和谐的大局观考虑，我在婚后一年对自己了系统的改造。
en: Out of a sense of the bigger picture — to foster family unity and promote socialist harmony — I gave myself a systematic overhaul a year after we married.

text: 全方面杜绝了和老婆发生冲突的可能。
en: I eliminated all possibility of conflict with my wife across the board.

text: 谁让咱是爷们呢，不跟她一般见识！
en: Well, who made me a real man? I'm not going to stoop to her level!

text: 第三阶段：重振夫纲
en: Stage Three: Reasserting the Husband's Authority

text: --嫌我学问浅？
en: --Think my learning is shallow?

text: 以你买衣服的速度来买书，反正我要补的专业知识不是一点半点，以前总想着买书太浪费钱，现在被人骑到头上我能那么善罢甘休？
en: Buy books at the speed you buy clothes; anyway, the professional knowledge I need to make up is no small amount, and after always thinking books were too wasteful before, now that someone's riding on my head, how could I just let it go?

text: 买！
en: Buy!

text: 不就多申请几次经费么，多大的事！
en: It's just applying for funding a few more times — what's the big deal!

text: --嫌我举止糙？
en: --Think my manners are crude?

text: 装斯文可是老子的强项，不就是吃饭不bia叽嘴么，只要能把你嘴堵上，让我吃饭不张嘴都没问题！
en: Putting on refinement is my forte; it's just not smacking my lips while eating — as long as I can shut your mouth, I'd eat without opening mine if need be!

text: --嫌我邋遢？
en: --Think I'm slovenly?

text: 洗衣服谁不会！
en: Who can't wash clothes!

text: 晒衣服谁不会！
en: Who can't hang clothes out to dry!

text: 叠衣服谁不会！
en: Who can't fold clothes!

text: 收拾衣柜谁不会！
en: Who can't tidy a wardrobe!

text: 就你有嘴，一天天的叭叭叭叭，我天天把衣服都特么洗了，让你想洗都没机会！
en: You're the only one with a mouth, blabbering on day after day; I wash all the clothes every single day, so you don't even get the chance to wash them!

text: --嫌我懒？
en: --Think I'm lazy?

text: 买那么多书拿来干嘛的？
en: What did I buy all those books for?

text: 看呀！
en: To read!

text: 天天书房守住，你再喊老子跟你一起看韩剧试试？
en: I'll guard the study every day — you try calling me to watch Korean dramas with you again!

text: 家务就你会干？
en: You're the only one who can do housework?

text: 看把你能的，你给我闪开，看看什么叫把地扫出人影来！
en: Look at you acting all capable — get out of my way and watch me sweep the floor so clean you can see your reflection!

text: --嫌我爱好娘？
en: --Think my hobbies are girly?

text: 登山、骑行、半马，整啊！
en: Mountain climbing, cycling, half marathons — let's do them all!

text: 反正200斤的体重，谁差那点脂肪？
en: Anyway, at 200 jin in weight, who's short on a bit of fat?

text: --嫌我脾气差？
en: --Think my temper is bad?

text: 你尽管BB，还一句嘴算我输！
en: You go on babbling all you like; if I talk back once, I lose!

text: 切，小样，我还治不了你了！
en: Psh, you little thing — you think I can't handle you!

text: 在我的凛凛夫纲之下，现在我一回家，我老婆对我那叫一个亲热。
en: Under my awe-inspiring husbandly authority, now as soon as I get home my wife is utterly affectionate towards me.

text: 女人啊，还是得管！
en: Women — they still need to be kept in line!

text: 说一下，TZ市就是泰州市，评论区不需要再猜了，我也不怕得罪人了，咋的吧，我没有地域黑的意思，这事的确是在这个地方发生的，该女生就是当地人。
en: Let me clarify: TZ City is Taizhou City, so the comment section need not guess any more; I'm not afraid of offending anyone either — so what — I mean no regional prejudice, this really did happen in this place, and that young woman is a local.

text: 我和兄弟们都是土生土长安徽人，为啥非要猜我们是东北人？
en: My mates and I are all native-born Anhui people; why must you insist on guessing we're from Dongbei?

text: 只有东北人会干架吗？
en: Are only Dongbei people the ones who fight?

text: 兄弟很壮，胖是胖些，但是看起来没有不健康的感觉，属于灵动的胖子那种。
en: The brother is quite sturdy; he's a bit on the plump side, but he doesn't look unhealthy — he's one of those lively chubby types.

text: 他家里宠他，那是物质上的宠爱，在精神上他是一个足够成熟的青年人。
en: His family spoils him materially; spiritually, he is a sufficiently mature young man.

text: 我说他喜欢看动画片喜欢宅，这事不伤天害理吧？
en: When I say he likes watching cartoons and staying indoors, that's hardly a terrible crime, is it?

text: 而且，这只是外行人的刻板印象，我只是拿来举例，实际上人家足球等运动项目也玩得很好。
en: Moreover, that is only a layman's stereotype; I merely used it as an example — in fact, he's actually quite good at sports like football.

text: 不要吐槽踢得一手好足球这事啦…
en: Don't mock the fact that he plays a fine game of football…

text: 以下是原回答:
en: Below is the original answer:

text: 大三寒假之前，一个玩得最交心的兄弟打来电话，哭天抹泪说他被绿了。
en: Before the winter break of my third year, a brother I was closest to called me, weeping and wailing that he'd been cuckolded.

text: 这兄弟身高180体重也是180，宅得各种动漫，也踢得一手好足球，从来也不愧于“硬汉两个字”。
en: This brother is 180 cm in height and 180 jin in weight, is glued to all kinds of anime at home, yet also plays a fine game of football, and has never been unworthy of the word 'tough guy'.

text: 他家里有点底子，爷爷是老革命，叔伯一辈混得不好的是个科长，家里很宠。
en: His family has some background: his grandfather was an old revolutionary, and among his uncles the least successful is a section chief, and the family dotes on him.

text: 他很喜欢打游戏，但是自从谈了这个对象就从来没换过设备，游戏里没花一分钱，回回打电话过去约游戏都说在跟对象约会，今天又下的什么什么馆子。
en: He loved playing games, but ever since he got this girlfriend he never upgraded his gear, never spent a penny in-game, and every time we called to arrange a game he'd say he was on a date with his girlfriend, or what restaurant he'd taken her to today.

text: 我自我感觉也是个深情滴男银，但是跟他比还是比不了。
en: I always thought of myself as a deeply affectionate bloke, but compared with him I fall short.

text: 当时我也懵逼，以前也没遇到这种事情，安慰他半天，最后决元旦过去看望他，因为我们学校放假比较早。
en: Back then I was also stunned; I'd never encountered such a thing, comforted him for ages, and finally decided to go and visit him over New Year, because our university broke up earlier.

text: 元旦去了，几个哥们齐聚一堂，汇于TZ市。
en: At New Year we went; a few mates gathered together and converged on Taizhou City.

text: 哥几个互相有逼数，今个来了就是要干那奸夫的。
en: We lads all knew the score; coming here today was to deal with that adulterer.

text: 兄弟摆摆手，说别了，没意义。
en: The brother waved his hand and said forget it, it's meaningless.

text: 于是就吃饭喝酒，夜里爬在我们几个肩膀上挨个哭。
en: So we ate and drank, and at night he climbed onto our shoulders one by one and cried.

text: 你知道他说为啥不能把那厮打一顿吗？
en: Do you know why he said we couldn't give that bastard a beating?

text: 因为打了他把事情闹大了对他前女友名声不好。
en: Because beating him would make a scene and hurt his ex-girlfriend's reputation.

text: 操蛋，哥几个仰天长叹。
en: Bloody hell, we lads sighed up at the sky.

text: 他在外面工作，再苦再累回家也从来不会说什么，站在门口整理一下衣服，试着笑了笑，掏出钥匙打开了家门。
en: He worked away from home, and no matter how hard or tiring it was he never complained when he got back; he'd stand at the door, straighten his clothes, try to smile, take out his key and open the front door.

text: 他第一次坐飞机，看见飞机上发的飞机餐，却不舍得吃，留下来拿给他儿子吃。
en: The first time he took a plane, he saw the in-flight meal they handed out but couldn't bear to eat it, saving it to take home for his son.

text: 他因为想省钱，吃了不卫生的东西，在外地出差食物中毒却不跟家里说。
en: Because he wanted to save money, he ate unhygienic food, got food poisoning on a business trip away from home, yet never told his family.

text: 赶上了下岗大潮，却不跟老婆孩子说，每天去找工作，给赚钱就干。
en: He was caught up in the wave of lay-offs, yet never told his wife and children; every day he went looking for work and took any job that paid.

text: 他慢慢变老，头发慢慢变白，几十年好像一个瞬间。
en: He slowly grew old, his hair slowly turned white, and several decades passed like a single moment.

text: 他开始听不懂儿子说的那些词汇：B2B,B2C，但是却努力去学，好像重新回到了上学的时候，为的是跟儿子能多点沟通。
en: He began not to understand the words his son used — B2B, B2C — yet he strove to learn them, as if returning to his schooldays, so as to communicate more with his son.

text: 他为了多跟儿子说说话，开始学习用微信，带着老花眼镜，一步一步的注册，不会了就打电话问公司的小年轻。
en: To talk with his son more, he started learning to use WeChat, putting on his reading glasses, registering step by step, and when he got stuck he'd call the young folk at the company.

text: 每次儿子给他打电话，他总是故作不耐烦的样子，你是不是又开车呢？
en: Every time his son called, he'd put on an impatient front: 'Are you driving again?'

text: 开车就好好开车，别打电话。
en: If you're driving, then drive properly and don't make calls.

text: 每次儿子给他买了新奇的东西，换了新手机，他表面上总是一副严肃的样子：又乱花钱！
en: Every time his son bought him something novel or a new phone, he'd put on a stern face: 'Wasting money again!'

text: 背地里拿着礼物开心的跟一个孩子一样。
en: But in private he'd be as happy with the gift as a child.

text: 他老是担心儿子不好好吃饭，担心儿子赚不到钱，担心儿子受欺负了。
en: He was always worried his son wasn't eating properly, worried he wasn't earning enough, worried he was being bullied.

text: 他告诉儿子花钱别不舍得花，但是自己越不舍得花钱，一副眼镜带了几十年。
en: He told his son not to begrudge spending money, yet he himself begrudged it more and more, wearing a single pair of glasses for decades.

text: 他知道自己变老了，走路的时候总是努力挺起胸，让自己的背不显得那么弓，却不知道其实在儿子眼里他越来越高大。
en: He knew he was getting old, and when walking he always tried to straighten his chest so his back wouldn't stoop so much, unaware that in his son's eyes he was growing ever taller.

text: 他总想儿子快结婚，快成家立业，快有个家。
en: He always wanted his son to marry soon, to settle down and build a career, to have a home soon.

text: 他总是喜欢跟别人吹牛，说自己的儿子多有出息，工作不错，还会摄影，当了很多人的老师。
en: He always liked to boast to others that his son was so promising, had a good job, and could even do photography, having become many people's teacher.

text: 他是我的父亲。
en: He is my father.

text: 我记得我小时候的QQ签名是：总有一天，我也会有能力去守护我爱的人。
en: I remember that when I was little my QQ signature read: 'One day, I too will have the ability to protect those I love.'

text: 现在我知道了，不管能力大小，都要去守护自己爱的人。
en: Now I know that, ability aside, I must protect those I love.

text: 因为是个男人。
en: Because I am a man.
